# Anatomy kit (vendored)

`kit/iso-kit.mjs` and `kit/lathe.mjs` are copied unchanged from
[wheresryan22/anatomy](https://github.com/wheresryan22/anatomy) at commit
`240a9bf7c50cc6226148762a1017466fcbc08523`, under the MIT license in `LICENSE`.
They are the isometric camera, solids, shading and SVG renderer the game is drawn with.
